function.name: ifms_check_eligibility
function.description: Checks farmer's eligibility for fertilizer subsidy based on Aadhaar-linked records, land size, crop type, and season. Subsidy is purchase-linked — it reduces the price at point of sale, NOT a direct cash transfer. Returns eligibility_status ('eligible', 'not_eligible') with quantity limits. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate purchase. Fails if farmer has no land records, crop-fertilizer mismatch, or quantity limits already exhausted for the season.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: ifms_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for iFMS fertilizer subsidy authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.
